nodes.description: TWST.admin address state variable holding the privileged account set from msg.sender in the constructor.
ERC20._balances mapping(address => uint) tracking token balances.
ERC20._allowances nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) tracking spend approvals.
ERC20._totalSupply uint holding the total token supply (1,000,000 * 10**18).
ERC20Detailed._name private string ('Twist Coin').
ERC20Detailed._symbol private string ('TWST').
ERC20Detailed._decimals private uint8 (18).
msg.sender, the caller-controlled address used for admin assignment and every _msgSender() based transfer/approval.
TWST constructor: sets admin = msg.sender and mints the entire supply to admin.
ERC20.mint(address,uint) public function that increases _totalSupply and credits an arbitrary account with no access control.
ERC20.transfer(address,uint) public entry point delegating to _transfer with _msgSender().
ERC20.transferFrom(address,address,uint) public entry point performing _transfer plus allowance decrement.
ERC20.approve(address,uint) public entry point delegating to _approve with _msgSender().
ERC20.increaseAllowance(address,uint) public function adding to the caller's allowance via SafeMath.add.
ERC20.decreaseAllowance(address,uint) public function subtracting from the caller's allowance via SafeMath.sub.
ERC20._transfer(address,address,uint) internal routine updating _balances with SafeMath and emitting Transfer.
ERC20._approve(address,address,uint) internal routine writing _allowances and emitting Approval.
ERC20.balanceOf(address) view returning _balances[account].
ERC20.totalSupply() view returning _totalSupply.
ERC20.allowance(address,address) view returning _allowances[owner][spender].
SafeERC20.callOptionalReturn(IERC20,bytes) private helper executing an arbitrary external call on a token contract.
SafeERC20.safeTransfer(IERC20,address,uint) internal wrapper building transfer calldata.
SafeERC20.safeTransferFrom(IERC20,address,address,uint) internal wrapper building transferFrom calldata.
SafeERC20.safeApprove(IERC20,address,uint) internal wrapper with allowance zero-check before approve.
Address.isContract(address) internal view using inline assembly extcodehash to detect contracts.
Context._msgSender() internal view returning msg.sender.
ERC20Detailed constructor storing name, symbol and decimals parameters into state.
SafeMath.add(uint,uint) internal pure with overflow require.
SafeMath.sub(uint,uint) internal pure with underflow require.
SafeMath.mul(uint,uint) internal pure with overflow require.
SafeMath.div(uint,uint) internal pure with division-by-zero require.
Low-level external call address(token).call(data) forwarding token address and calldata before return-value checks, an external-call/reentrancy surface.
Unpermissioned public mint(address,uint) allowing any caller to inflate _totalSupply and credit arbitrary balances (missing access control).
Inline assembly block reading extcodehash(account) inside isContract.
Raw unchecked arithmetic primitives (a + b, a - b, a * b, a / b) computed inside the SafeMath library before the guard requires.
address sender parameter of _transfer.
address recipient parameter of _transfer.
uint amount parameter of _transfer.
address owner parameter of _approve.
address spender parameter of _approve.
uint amount parameter of _approve.
address account parameter of mint (attacker-controlled recipient).
uint amount parameter of mint (attacker-controlled minted quantity).
IERC20 token parameter of callOptionalReturn, the target of the low-level call.
bytes data parameter of callOptionalReturn, the externally supplied calldata.
address spender parameter of the public approve function.
uint amount parameter of the public approve function.
address sender parameter of transferFrom.
address recipient parameter of transferFrom.
uint amount parameter of transferFrom.
Local uint c in SafeMath.add holding the raw sum before the overflow guard.
address account parameter of isContract hashed via extcodehash.
string name parameter of the ERC20Detailed constructor.
string symbol parameter of the ERC20Detailed constructor.
uint8 decimals parameter of the ERC20Detailed constructor.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns admin = msg.sender, giving the deployer/caller privileged control over the token in the TWST contract.
_msgSender() returns the untrusted msg.sender address.
transfer passes _msgSender() as the sender argument into _transfer.
approve/increase/decreaseAllowance pass _msgSender() as owner into _approve.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as the spender when decrementing allowance.
increaseAllowance reads and writes allowances keyed by _msgSender().
decreaseAllowance reads and writes allowances keyed by _msgSender().
allowance() reads the _allowances nested mapping.
balanceOf() reads the _balances mapping.
totalSupply() returns the _totalSupply state variable.
transfer delegates the balance movement to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates the balance movement to _transfer.
transferFrom decrements the spender allowance through _approve.
approve delegates the allowance write to _approve.
increaseAllowance writes the new allowance through _approve.
decreaseAllowance writes the reduced allowance through _approve.
transfer invokes _msgSender() to resolve the caller.
approve invokes _msgSender() to resolve the owner.
mint uses SafeMath.add for _totalSupply and balance updates.
mint writes _balances[account] for an arbitrary account supplied by the caller.
mint increases the _totalSupply state variable.
TWST constructor writes the admin state variable from msg.sender with no ownership transfer mechanism.
TWST constructor computes _totalSupply as 1000000 * (10**uint256(18)) with raw arithmetic outside SafeMath.
ERC20Detailed constructor writes the _name state variable.
ERC20Detailed constructor writes the _symbol state variable.
ERC20Detailed constructor writes the _decimals state variable.
SafeMath.add stores the raw sum a + b into local variable c before the require check.
SafeMath.add performs raw uint addition (a + b) that is mapped to the arithmetic operation sink.
SafeMath.sub performs raw uint subtraction (a - b, b - a) mapped to the arithmetic operation sink.
SafeMath.mul performs raw uint multiplication (a * b) mapped to the arithmetic operation sink.
SafeMath.div performs raw uint division (a / b) mapped to the arithmetic operation sink.
safeTransfer forwards encoded transfer calldata to callOptionalReturn.
safeTransferFrom forwards encoded transferFrom calldata to callOptionalReturn.
safeApprove forwards encoded approve calldata to callOptionalReturn.
callOptionalReturn requires address(token).isContract() before making the external call.
isContract executes an inline assembly block reading extcodehash.
callOptionalReturn performs an external low-level call to an arbitrary token contract, which can re-enter the calling contract before state is settled.
The attacker-influenced IERC20 token parameter is the target address of the low-level call.
The bytes data parameter is forwarded verbatim as calldata to the external low-level call.
mint() is publicly reachable and contains no owner/admin check, leading to unrestricted minting.
Unrestricted mint allows any caller to inflate the _totalSupply state variable.
Unrestricted mint credits arbitrary caller-chosen accounts in _balances.
_transfer debits and credits the _balances mapping.
_approve writes the _allowances nested mapping.
sender parameter flows into the _transfer balance debit.
recipient parameter flows into the _transfer balance credit.
amount parameter flows into the SafeMath guarded balance arithmetic in _transfer.
owner parameter indexes the _allowances write in _approve.
spender parameter indexes the _allowances write in _approve.
amount parameter is stored into the allowance slot in _approve.
account parameter selects the credited balance inside mint.
amount parameter is added to _totalSupply and the account balance inside mint.
token parameter is passed into callOptionalReturn to build the external call.
data parameter is passed into callOptionalReturn as the raw calldata payload.
spender parameter flows into the public approve allowance write.
amount parameter flows into the public approve allowance write.
sender parameter flows into transferFrom and then into _transfer.
recipient parameter flows into transferFrom and then into _transfer.
amount parameter flows into transferFrom allowance subtraction and transfer.
account parameter is hashed by the extcodehash assembly in isContract.
name parameter is stored into the _name state variable.
symbol parameter is stored into the _symbol state variable.
decimals parameter is stored into the _decimals state variable.
